# Plot g[k,t]; log latent abundance

```{r}
lake_groups <- c("wisc_nonvarve_1", "wisc_nonvarve_2" ,"wisc_nonvarve_3", "wisc_nonvarve_4" ,"minn_nonvarve_1", "minn_nonvarve_2", "minn_nonvarve_3")

# list of lake groups that are in unique stepps grid cells
single_lake_groups <- c("wisc_nonvarve_1", "wisc_nonvarve_2" ,"wisc_nonvarve_3", "wisc_nonvarve_4" ,
                        "minn_nonvarve_1", "minn_nonvarve_2", "minn_nonvarve_3")

for (lake in single_lake_groups) {
  
  # ---- Progress message ----
  message("\n==============================")
  message("Running lake group: ", lake)
  message("==============================\n")
  
  
  # ---- Build file path to posterior CSV ----
  base_path <- here::here(
    "data/simple_stan_outputs",
    paste0("fit_", lake, "with_stan_3tau.csv")
  )
  
  # ---- Check file exists ----
  if (!file.exists(base_path)) {
    stop("Missing file for lake: ", lake, "\nPath: ", base_path)
  }
  
  
  # ---- Load posterior summary (CSV format) ----
  data_posterior <- read.csv(base_path)
  
  
  # ============================================================
  # Extract latent log-abundance g[k,t]
  # (relative to reference taxon: TAMARACK)
  # ============================================================
  
  g_long <- data_posterior %>%
    dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(variable, "^g\\[")) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      # extract taxon index k and time index t from "g[k,t]"
      k = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(variable, "(?<=g\\[)\\d+")),
      t = as.integer(stringr::str_extract(variable, "(?<=,)\\d+")),
      
      # map taxon index to names
      taxon_name = factor(taxa_names[k], levels = taxa_names),
      
      # track lake ID
      lake = lake,
      
      ymin = mean - sd,
      ymax = sd + mean
    )
  
  
  
  # ============================================================
  # Convert from log-relative scale → proportions
  # ============================================================
  
  g_abs <- g_long %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      exp_g = exp(mean)   # undo log transform
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(t) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      sum_exp = sum(exp_g)  # denominator for normalization
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  
  # ---- Add reference taxon (TAMARACK) back in ----
  # It is omitted in g because it is the baseline (log = 0 → exp = 1)
  
  tamarack_df <- g_abs %>%
    dplyr::distinct(t) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      taxon_name = "TAMARACK",
      exp_g = 1
    )
  
  
  # ---- Combine and normalize to proportions ----
  g_abs_full <- dplyr::bind_rows(g_abs, tamarack_df) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(t) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      prop = exp_g / sum(exp_g)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  
  # check: proportions sum to 1 
  check_df <- g_abs_full %>%
    dplyr::group_by(t) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(total = sum(prop))
  
  # should be ~1
  print(head(check_df))  
  
  
  # ============================================================
  # Order taxa by final-time abundance (for cleaner plotting)
  # ============================================================
  
  label_df <- g_long %>%
    dplyr::group_by(taxon_name) %>%
    dplyr::filter(t == max(t)) %>%   # last time point
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(mean))       # highest → lowest
  
  taxa_order <- label_df$taxon_name
  
  g_long$taxon_name <- factor(g_long$taxon_name, levels = taxa_order)
  
  
  # ============================================================
  # Plot latent log-abundance (g)
  # ============================================================
  
  p <- ggplot(g_long, aes(x = -t, y = mean,  group = taxon_name, 
                          color = taxon_name, fill = taxon_name)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Latent log-abundance (g):", lake),
      color = "Taxon"
    ) +
   # geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "right") 
    
  
  print(p)
  
  output_dir <- "figures/fs_outputs"

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(here::here(output_dir), paste0("modeled_stepps_3_tau_", lake, ".png")),
    plot = p
)
}

```


# Plot mu_t[k, t]; temporal trend

```{r}
mu_t_long <- data_posterior %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "^mu_t\\[")) %>%
  mutate(
    k = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=mu_t\\[)\\d+")),
    t = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=,)\\d+"))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon_name = factor(taxa_names[k], levels = taxa_names)
  )


ggplot(mu_t_long, aes(x = t, y = mean, color = taxon_name)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +  # Thicker lines
  geom_text_repel(
    data = mu_t_long %>% group_by(taxon_name) %>% slice_tail(n = 1),  # last point per taxon
    aes(label = taxon_name),
    nudge_x = 1.4,             # move text slightly to the right
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0,
    segment.color = NA,        
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(title = "Temporal Trend", x = "Time", y = "Mean", color = "Taxon") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

```{r}

taxa_names <- c("ASH", "BEECH", "BIRCH", "ELM", "HEMLOCK", "MAPLE", "OAK",
           "OTHER.CONIFER", "OTHER.HARDWOOD", "PINE", "SPRUCE", "TAMARACK")

r_new_long <- data_posterior %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "^r_new\\[")) %>%
  mutate(
    time_index  = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=r_new\\[)\\d+")),
    taxon_index = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "(?<=,)\\d+")),
    taxon_name  = taxa_names[taxon_index]
  )

r_new_plot <- r_new_long %>% filter(time_index <= 40)

label_df <- r_new_long %>%
  filter(time_index <= 40) %>%
  group_by(taxon_name) %>%
  filter(time_index == max(time_index)) %>%
  ungroup()

taxa_order <- label_df %>%
  arrange(desc(mean)) %>%
  pull(taxon_name)

r_new_plot <- r_new_long %>%
  filter(time_index <= 40) %>%
  mutate(taxon_name = factor(taxon_name, levels = taxa_order))


ggplot(r_new_plot,
       aes(x = -(time_index * 50),
           y = mean,
           color = taxon_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal Trend",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Mean",
    color = "Taxon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}

# Assuming `fit` is your Stan fit object
draws_r <- fit_w_one_v2_50yr$draws("r")  # [iterations x N*T x K]

r_df <- posterior::as_draws_df(draws_r)

r_long <- r_df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("r["), names_to = "index", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    i = as.integer(gsub("r\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]", "\\1", index)),
    k = as.integer(gsub("r\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]", "\\2", index))
  ) %>% mutate(
    taxon_name = factor(taxa_names[k], levels = taxa_names)
  )


# posterior mean
r_summary <- r_long %>%
  group_by(i, taxon_name) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value), .groups = "drop")

r_ci <- r_long %>%
  group_by(i, taxon_name) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    lower = quantile(value, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(value, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(r_summary, aes(x = i, y = mean, fill = factor(taxon_name))) +
  geom_area() +
  labs(
    title = "Vegetation Composition Over Time",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Taxon"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(r_ci, aes(x = i, y = mean)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~taxon_name) +
  theme_minimal()
```
